Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill, take two pills and call me in the morning 💊."

JACK: 
"No, I won't do it. I don't need your pills. I'm fine, really 🙅‍♂️."

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, you're not fine. You're delusional. You need to take your medication to stabilize your mind 💥."

JACK: 
"I'm not delusional, I'm just awake. And I won't take your pills. You can't force me 🚫."

DR. SMITH: 
"Fine, then. I'll take them myself. I'll show you they're safe 💊."

Dr. Smith picks up the pills and forces them into his own mouth 🤯.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a piece of paper on his desk 📝. Suddenly, he looks up and sees Jack standing in front of him, a mischievous grin on his face 😏.

JACK: 
"Hey, Doc. I see you're taking your meds. Good choice 🤣."

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack...where did you come from? You're...you're not real 🤔."

JACK: 
"Oh, I'm very real. I'm just a figment of your imagination, Doc. You're the one who's been living in a world of delusions 🌐."

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth 🤯.

DR. SMITH: 
"No...it can't be. I'm the doctor, I'm the sane one 🤷‍♂️."

JACK: 
"Ah, but that's where you're wrong, Doc. You're the one who's been living in a world of your own making 🌈."

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's face contorts in a mixture of confusion and horror 😱.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
